Symbol of the most feared man in the galaxy. Vader’s control of the dark side of the Force allows him to wield this weapon in surprising ways. |game_text=Deploy on Vader. May target a character or creature. Draw two destiny. Target hit if total destiny > defense value. Also, during a duel, Vader may ‘throw’ this lightsaber to add 1 to each of his duel destiny draws (place lightsaber in Used Pile at end of duel). |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Darth Vader's Lightsaber]]
